headline: 3 deaths from dengue in 24 hours, 580 newly hospitalized
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a surge in dengue cases across Bangladesh, with 59 total deaths this year.
details: Three people died from dengue fever in the last 24 hours across the country, according to a press release from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) on Monday.
A total of 580 new patients were admitted to hospitals for dengue treatment during the same period.

The distribution of new admissions includes 125 patients from the Dhaka division (outside city corporations), 78 from Dhaka South City Corporation, 59 from Dhaka North City Corporation, and 81 from Barishal division.
Other affected areas include Chattogram (79), Khulna (67), Mymensingh (36), Rangpur (31), and Rajshahi (22), with two patients admitted in Sylhet division.
The DGHS stated that 16,684 people have been infected with dengue this year so far, with 62.2% being men and 37.8% being women.
Out of the total infected, 15,344 patients have recovered and been discharged from hospitals.
The total number of dengue-related deaths in the country has now reached 59 for the current year.

headline: 847 children dead as measles symptoms claim 3 more lives in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports 1,080 new cases of measles or measles-like symptoms across Bangladesh in a single day.
details: Three more children died within 24 hours (Sunday 8 AM to Monday 8 AM) showing symptoms of measles, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) on Monday.
caption:
847 children have died since March 15, with 3 more claiming lives in the last 24 hours.

Three more children died within 24 hours (Sunday 8 AM to Monday 8 AM) showing symptoms of measles, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) on Monday.
